newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Keppel Land integrates four subsidiaries.
newsitem.headline: Keppel Land integrates four subsidiaries.

text.p: Keppel Land Ltd said on Wednesday it would integrate four of its key management subsidiaries into one company, Keppel Land International Ltd, with effect from April 10.

The subsidiaries are property development arm Steamship Investment & Development Pte Ltd, marketing unit Straits Mansfield Property Marketing Pte Ltd, property management company Straits Property Management Pte Ltd and Straits Steamship Retail Management Pte Ltd.

"The integration, which brings our subsidiaries together under a common banner, allows them to benefit from direct association with their parent Keppel Land," chairman and managing director Lim Chee Onn said in a statement.
Keppel Land's hotel management arm, Sedona Hotels International, will continue to operate under Sedona, the statement said..
